subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

All Greek to me

options.text: Something that is ancient and classic
Something that is harmful to all
Something that is fancy and classy

solution:
The correct answer is: **'****Something that is not understandable'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"All Greek to me"** means something that is not understandable or incomprehensible. (मुझे कुछ समझ में नहीं आता)

 
 
• **Example:** I tried reading the manual, but it's **all Greek to me**.
 
 
 
• **"Not understandable"** refers to something that cannot be easily comprehended or understood. (असमझनीय)
 
• **​**Hence, we can infer that the idiom "**All Greek to me**" means "**not understandable**".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Something that is ancient and classic** (प्राचीन और क्लासिक): Refers to something that is old and has stood the test of time.

 
 
• **Example:** The architecture of the building is **ancient and classic**, reminiscent of the Roman era.
 
 
 
• **Something that is harmful to all** (सभी के लिए हानिकारक): Refers to something that causes damage or harm to everyone.
 
 
• **Example:** The toxic waste dumped in the river is **harmful to all** living beings in the area.
 
 
 
• **Something that is fancy and classy** (शानदार और क्लासी): Refers to something that is stylish and elegant.
 
 
• **Example:** She wore a **fancy and classy** dress to the gala event.
